messages:
sre-bot: ⚠️ Alert: p99 latency breach on /v1/streaming/generate in us-west-2. p95 ~ 600ms, p99 ~ 4.2s. Error rate 0.6% (small), but streaming stalls observed. Cache miss rate for prefix-cache jumped to 87% over last 5m.

june_oncall: seeing the same on the dashboard — live traces show tail stalls in the streaming shard pool. Any recent deploys to prefix hashing? :eyes:

maya: I rolled a small change to prefix-salt hashing at 09:12UTC to fix a collision edgecase. It was on runtime/model-routing. Could be related.

omar: that change only touched the prefix hashing function and a small rollout to canary (10% traffic) at 09:12. We ramped to 50% at 09:22 and 100% at 09:28.

alex: customer-support pinged re: degraded streaming for a high-value customer, they reported partial transcripts missing and long stalls at ~09:35.

june_oncall: hypothesis: prefix-salt change altered key distribution causing widespread cache prefix misses -> backpressure on paging layer -> tail stalls.

maya: logs from prefix-cache nodes show a spike in key space entropy after 09:22. snippet: ```
[09:25:12] prefix-cache miss_rate=0.88 shard=us-west-2-3 prefix_hash=0x7f9c...
[09:25:13] kv-page-fetch latency=1.2s backend=db-paging-03
```

omar: rolling back the prefix-salt change is quick — it's a single flag flip in the routing layer. We can rollback to the previous hash function in a single patch and then roll forward if not fixed.

june_oncall: do it. Prioritize availability. Triggered mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to legacy prefix (already on standby), 2) increase prefetch window to reduce cold fetches, 3) temporarily raise streaming concurrency on dedicated shards to absorb tail latency.

maya: initiating rollback to legacy prefix hashing now. Deploy command: ```./deploy --service routing --env prod --revision revert/prefix-salt-2025-09-12```

sre-bot: deploy started by maya at 09:42 UTC. CI checks passed. Rolling canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic monitoring gates.

alex: lowering customer impact label to medium and notifying CS. Sending a short blurb to the affected customer: "We’re investigating increased streaming latency and have triggered mitigations; you may see improved behavior in the next 5-10 minutes."

june_oncall: monitoring realtime: after canary rollback (09:47) miss rate dropped from 87% -> 63% in 3m. p99 now 2.1s. Keep watching.

omar: full rollback completed at 09:55. Verifying cache warmup. Running a targeted warming job against hot prefixes for the next 10m.```

maya: warming job started: ```python -m tools.warm_cache --prefixes-file hot_prefixes_2025-09-12.txt --concurrency 50 --region us-west-2```

june_oncall: post-warm metrics: miss rate 12% after 6m, p99 down to 380ms, streaming stalls disappeared in traces. Good sign.

alex: CS updated — customers seeing improvements, one reported full recovery. Marking initial customer impact as 'partial transcript loss' -> resolved.

product-support: are there any remaining degraded buckets or particular model versions affected? we need a concise list for postmortem.

omar: initial correlates: traffic routed through routing revision rev-2025-09-12-a; models using long-prefix tokenization patterns (seq_len > 1024) had higher miss amplification. I'll dump route logs and attach in postmortem.

june_oncall: immediate actions summary for handoff: 1) rollback prefix-salt change (done), 2) forced cache warm and prefetch adjustments (done), 3) raised concurrency temporarily (reverted at 10:20), 4) monitoring alerts adjusted to reduce noise.

maya: followups to assign: - eng-runtime: add canary guard (rate-limited ramp) and automated lookback on key distribution delta; - infra: add synthetic warmers that exercise long-prefix patterns; - SRE: improve alert to include prefix-entropy metric.

alex: I'm creating a customer timeline and will coordinate PM/CS comms.

product-support: please tag any customers impacted and include sample request ids. I'll consolidate.

omar: attaching quick repro snippets in thread: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/streaming/generate -d '{"prompt": "<long-chat-history>"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``` large prefix keys showed cache miss behavior.

june_oncall: ok wrapping up. On-call handoff to @alex in 30 minutes. Current status: mitigated, monitoring green, postmortem to be owned by eng-runtime + SRE.

alex: taking handoff. Summary for next oncall: timeline, rollback revision, warmers ran, customer list, followups (canary policy + synthetic warmers + alerting). I'll open the incident ticket and link this thread.

sre-bot: Incident closed to live mitigation stage at 10:48 UTC — followups required for postmortem.

maya: adding a quick note: we should consider adding a pre-compute mapping for long-prefix tokenization to avoid sudden distribution shifts on hash changes.

omar: agree — I'll schedule a small design review tomorrow.

alex: good job team. I'll draft the incident summary and assign action items. If anyone has remaining logs or request ids, paste them here before 11:15 UTC. :thumbsup:
